title: Sturdy, substantial weight
text: Sturdy, substantial weight. I purchased this "used" which said it had been repackaged. In fact, there are some surface defects in the muffin cups. However, I wanted an inexpensive pan, and I got a good price for it. I was surprised the heft of the metal, thinking it would be very lightweight. I am not a fan of silicone pans because they are so floppy. I will not use this much, so Im happy with what I got.
